question: Can lua_momentum reach win rate >= 0.80 and profit factor >= 1.2 after taker fees, out of sample, with no same-round re-entry?
answer: No. Defaults other than the threshold-unit fix were not changed.

execution.entry: maker at floor(mid - 0.005, 0.01); fill only when a later 60s mid trades at or below that bid; entry fee 0
execution.exit_fee: shares * 0.07 * p * (1-p) with p = the bid at the sell
execution.reentry: forbidden after a sell in the same condition and round
execution.settlement_source: gamma outcomePrices in {0,1} must match the series terminal 0/1 point; mismatches and unresolved markets dropped
execution.spread_basis: median two-sided spread on the four checked-in L2 hours is $0.01 (n=97932)

selection.rule: On IS only, among configs with n>=150, maximize min(wr/0.80, min(pf,3)/1.20). A target hit also required robustness: >=2 assets with n>=30 and PF>=1, and both durations PF>=0.8 when each has n>=30. OOS was scored once, for baseline and the selected config.
selection.shipped_behavior: threshold comparison corrected from percent-points to a fraction so manifest default 0.04 means 4%. No other default changed. The selected config was not shipped: it loses money out of sample and failed the robustness rule.

pre_fix_threshold_bug.note: Before this change, classify() computed a percent-point move and compared it with threshold 0.04, so a 0.04% move armed. On 60-second bars most moves already exceed 4%, so the bug and the 4% rule produce similar trade counts. On a tick book the bug arms on flicker.

unconditional_price_ceiling.note: Not a strategy. At the minute nearest the target time-left, settlement frequency of a token whose mid falls in that 0.05 bin. taker_pf buys the ask and pays the taker fee. maker_pf assumes a fill at the bid with NO adverse selection. The maker momentum strategy does not get that fill: it fills only when price trades down through the bid, and those fills win less often than the entry price.
